name: StarkNet
notes: Default and Circle: the official Starknet symbol SN-Symbol-Gradient.svg (#0C0C4F disc, #FAFAFA mark, #EC796B -> #E175B1 gradients), drawn full-bleed; it replaces artwork whose gradient ended in #D672EF (not in the kit) and whose Circle/Square marks were undersized
Square: no official tile exists; a repo-convention #0C0C4F rounded square (rx 31.6/158 = 12.8/64) holding the official mark paths at the symbol's own scale
Mono, CircleMono and SquareMono: the disc / tile in currentColor with the mark's four paths knocked out through a mask (the two swooshes touch, so fill-rule=evenodd would cancel their overlap)
